title: The Renewal Window
description: Patricia just wants to renew her parking permit. The form has 14,000 questions and the last one is about the end of the universe. Doreen at the counter is very patient about it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Our next caller has been sitting in a government office since this morning trying to renew a parking permit. Patricia, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Hi, Ronnie. Yes. I'm still here. <p:0.3> I took a number this morning. I am on form fourteen.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Form fourteen of what?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: They won't tell me, Barry. The lady at the window, Doreen, she just keeps sliding me another form.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And what does form fourteen ask?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: It asks for my name, my address, and... the date of my death.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The date of your... okay. Just leave that one blank.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: It won't let me, Barry. It's a required field. There's a little red star next to it.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Ma'am. <p:0.3> If you could just estimate the date of your death, we can keep the line moving.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I don't know it, Doreen.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Most people don't, hon. <p:0.3> That's section nine. Pull a number for section nine.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So you finish a form and they give you another form.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: There are always more forms, Ronnie. I counted the stack. <p:0.3> It does not get shorter when I work. It gets taller.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Taller. The stack gets taller.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Section nine asks where I was before I was born. <p:0.4> It has a drop down menu, Barry. There are options.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: What are the options, Patricia.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: The first one is, quote, the dark. <p:0.3> The second one is, the same dark. <p:0.3> The third one is, prefer not to say.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Pick prefer not to say. Always pick prefer not to say.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: She can't, hon. <p:0.3> Prefer not to say generates a follow up. <p:0.3> It would like to know why.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: It always wants to know why, Doreen. Every box. Why, why, why.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Doreen, how long does the renewal usually take?

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Depends on the applicant, hon. <p:0.3> Some folks finish in an afternoon. <p:0.3> Some are still here from the last building.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The... last building?

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: This one's newer. <p:0.3> We carried the stack over. <p:0.3> You don't lose your place in line for that, it carries.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: Ronnie, the man next to me has been filling out the same form since the nineteen forties. He says he's almost through.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Almost through is good. That's progress.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: He's on page one, Ronnie. <p:0.4> He is almost through page one.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Patricia, just walk out. Just stand up and walk out.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: There's no door, Barry! I came in through a door and now there's just more counter!

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: The exit's a separate form, hon. <p:0.3> Section infinity. <p:0.3> You'll get there.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Did she say section INFINITY?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: It's after section nine, Barry, but the numbers stopped going up. They just say more.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on. Doreen, surely there's a supervisor.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: I'm the supervisor, hon. <p:0.3> I've been the supervisor a very long time. <p:0.4> I came in to renew a permit, same as her.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: You're behind the counter, Doreen!

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: I filled out enough forms, hon. <p:0.4> Eventually they put you on the other side.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Patricia, get up. GET UP.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I'm filling faster, Barry! The stack's taller!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Stop filling!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: It's required!

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Little red star.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: What was I renewing?! <p:0.3> I forgot what I came for!

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: A parking permit, hon. <p:0.4> The car's long gone. <p:0.3> But the permit, the permit we keep current.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Patricia. <p:0.4> Patricia, are you still there?

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: ...One moment. <p:0.4> I'm being told I'm next. <p:0.3> The screen says one applicant ahead of me.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's good! That's almost done!

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: It's said one applicant ahead since Tuesday, Barry. <p:0.4> The applicant ahead of me is the building.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're gonna take a quick break before Patricia reaches the window. <p:0.3> Patricia, when you get there... renew ours too.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: Take a number, hon.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I'm not taking a number.

lines.speaker: clerk-doreen
lines.text: You already did, hon. <p:0.3> Nineteen forties. <p:0.3> You're almost through page one.
